name: declarations-merged-with-outside-ones
description: An interface a file that is no module declares merges into the global scope, and a module declaration may augment a module no import of the target names. Each is used where a declaration it holds is used, so an interface the language types a value by, and an augmentation of a dependency's module, are not reported while a use reads a member they declare, and a member nothing reads is reported by its own references.
